decisions.reason: As a simple trailer-related accessory it fits the firm's existing know-how and can be improved with little development effort, though its lower prominence than the main trailer lines makes it somewhat more expendable.

A box car trailer series is squarely within the firm's established trailer competence, and its home-page placement suggests positive early commercial relevance that the firm can build on through incremental learning.

A car transporter trailer is still closely related to the firm's core engineering base, and a dedicated product page indicates commitment, even if the segment may require more specialised adaptation than standard trailers.

A low-bed trailer series strongly leverages the firm's accumulated design and production knowledge, and its front-page visibility points to enough promise to justify continued refinement rather than withdrawal.

A high trailer cover series is an adjacent extension of the firm's existing trailer expertise, and its home-page presence suggests the firm sees enough market value to continue learning and improving it.

This box car trailer series also draws directly on the firm's core knowledge base, and despite possible overlap in the range, the firm's absorptive capacity favors retaining and differentiating it before considering exit.
